coverage.target: Byte-exact comparison with no tolerance; prompt-defined operation order, Go float64() conversions, OCaml let-bound products (security-design.md Boundary 3)
Generators run twice per check; data-parallel programs at 1 thread and at the core count (security-design.md Boundary 3)
sandbox-exec profile on macOS and bwrap on Linux, writes only in the run directory, no network, refusal when missing, canary and tree check as a second line (security-design.md Boundary 1)
Corpus job on every pull request on macOS and Linux with an early pass when nothing relevant changed, and nightly (security-design.md Required check)
Vendored rayon with per-crate owner approval and corpus/deny.toml; vendored domainslib with checksums and licence record (security-design.md Boundary 2)
20-minute checker budget after install and cache restore; hard job timeouts 45 and 120 minutes; caching keyed on pins and lockfiles (security-design.md Time limits)
Checker tests written first on synthetic corpora, including sandbox escape attempts (security-design.md Tests first)
setup-go and setup-ocaml pinned to commit SHAs with read-only permissions; installed versions checked against pins (security-design.md Boundary 2)
Offline cargo and dune builds from vendored sources; network denied by the sandbox (security-design.md Boundary 2, Boundary 1)
